selection_note: Encoder: fine-tuned all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (best on Wikipedia val and Stack Exchange ext_dev, smallest, fastest). Head: flat subtopic softmax = primary-subtopic classification with secondary sibling suggestions; re-compared with one-vs-rest and hierarchical sigmoid heads on the 1.2.0 corpus (D-33, reports/experiments/head_comparison.json); C=16 chosen on val. OOD threshold calibrated on real questions (E-9). min_confidence: largest grid value keeping >= 90% of ext_dev questions answered. Language gate: fastText lid.176 + lexicon, per-length reject confidence chosen on dev (D-30). See decisions.md D-22..D-29 and docs/MODEL_REPORT.md.

ood.note: chosen by scripts/ood_experiment.py on dev data (D-34)
